definition: The One itself is the designated entity one. Being that entity is identity x = one; not being it is x ≠ one. The entity is in the same domain as participants, so inequality is a substantive attributed commitment. This parameter alone supplies no existence theorem, uniqueness theorem, FormOf classification, purity inventory or causal role.
note: Identity-based projection of the contrast in Taylor proposition 2. The source claim attributes nonidentity of participants; it does not define the full Proclean account of the One. A fuller sourced definition requires further argument and source interpretation.
